# Eco Sure Testing LLC

> Eco Sure Testing LLC is an independent mold testing and inspection company serving Los Angeles and San Diego, California. The company performs testing and lab-certified reporting only — it does not perform mold remediation — which means its results carry no conflict of interest. Services include air quality (spore) testing, surface and swab sampling, moisture and leak detection, visual mold inspection, post-remediation clearance testing, and real estate / pre-purchase mold testing. Samples are analyzed by an accredited independent laboratory.

## Key facts
- Business name: Eco Sure Testing LLC
- What it does: Independent mold testing and inspection (testing only, no remediation)
- Service area: Los Angeles County and San Diego County, California, USA
- Phone: (323) 302-0661
- Website: https://ecosuretesting.com
- Hours: Sunday–Friday, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM (closed Saturday)
- Key differentiator: Conflict-free / unbiased — does not sell remediation, so testing results are impartial

## Services
- Air quality (spore) testing — detects hidden mold by comparing indoor to outdoor spore levels
- Surface & swab sampling — identifies the specific mold species on a visible spot
- Moisture & leak detection — locates the water source feeding mold
- Visual mold inspection — documents visible growth and high-risk conditions
- Post-remediation clearance testing — independent verification that cleanup worked
- Real estate & pre-purchase mold testing — documented reports for buyers, sellers, and agents
